speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I will not sign off on manual drift checks because they are simply too slow when a promotion week hits and demand spikes. You need an automated signal that flags the shift before the store managers start overriding the order suggestions.
output.correction: I am not saying we cannot look at the data at all, but I am rejecting the idea that a human eye is a reliable monitoring tool for this scale. The system must detect the drift automatically so we can react before the pallets are already stuck in the distribution centre.
